results.title: Mlinotest Announces Expansion of Production Capacity and Automation
results.description: Mlinotest, a leading Slovenian bakery, reveals its plans to increase production capacity for select baked goods and invest in advanced automation technologies in its testine factory. The company aims to expand its fresh bread production and seize new opportunities in foreign markets, responding to growing consumer demand and the need for competitive efficiency.

results.title: Polishing Holograms Could Mean Unnecessary Panel Rework: Why Bodyshops Should Diagnose Before They Correct
results.description: For automotive bodyshops, polishing holograms can create a costly dilemma: are the visible marks evidence of a deeper paint defect, contamination or simply an issue with the polishing process? Independent Paint Supplies (IPS Paint), a South Wales supplier serving trade professionals from Swansea and Cardiff, is encouraging refinish shop managers to establish the cause before deciding on panel rework.
